_comment: Built from discovery/FINDINGS.md, 2026-09-11. No credentials belong in this file - ESPN cookies are read from ESPN_S2 and ESPN_SWID in the environment only. Values that the API reports authoritatively (Sleeper roster_positions, team names, records) are NOT duplicated here; collectors read them live. This file holds identity, display choices, and the few facts the APIs do not provide.

_notes.slots: roster_positions is an ordered array from the API - QB,RB,RB,WR,WR,WR,TE,FLEX,FLEX,DEF - so the collector reads it live rather than hardcoding it here. 10 starting slots, two FLEX, no kicker.
_notes.rosterId: Derived at runtime by matching me.userId to owner_id. The value here is a cached hint and a cross-check; the collector warns if they disagree.
_notes.dynasty: Dynasty league. taxi and reserve players sit outside roster_positions and are excluded from bench totals.
_notes.bracket: winners_bracket and losers_bracket return fabricated pairings before the playoffs. Gated on playoffWeekStart.

_notes.slotOrder: ESPN returns lineupSlotCounts as an unordered map, unlike Sleeper's ordered array, so the display order is a choice made here. 10 rows: QB, RB, RB, WR, WR, TE, FLEX, SUPERFLEX, D/ST, K.
_notes.mirrorLogoHosts: Logos on mystique-api return 401 without cookies and the board loads images client-side, so the collector mirrors those into logoMirrorDir. 4 of 12 teams are affected, including me.
_notes.standings: 12 rows, so points-for is replaced by playoff percentage and a divider is drawn between seed 7 and 8 rather than highlighting 7 of 12 rows.
_notes.transactions: view=mTransactions2 with no x-fantasy-filter header. Filtering server-side returns 400. DRAFT records are filtered out client-side.
